payload.reason: The evidence provides information on features extracted from text, specifically in the context of Named Entity Recognition (NER) and its integration with image features.

claims.text: Named Entity Recognition (NER) extracts features from text to locate and classify named entities.
The approach integrates features extracted from images and text for classifying named entities.
NER approaches often rely on hand-crafted features and domain-specific knowledge for effective entity detection.
The proposed model does not depend on specific linguistic resources, indicating a shift in feature extraction methods.
